描述_EN: (cc 4/2/1985) some qing examples are shown in ''gugong qiqi tezhan mulu'' (taipei, 1981) nos 85-87. the technique seen on this object is known in the modern chinese literatrue as 'xipi' (rhinoceros hide), though there is discussion as to whether this is the 'xipi' mentioned in text of per-ming and ming date. this also illustrates a box closely comparable to the present piece, dated by the author as 'ming'. the fullest technical explanation is given by yuan quanyu (wife of wang shixiang), 'tan xipi qiqi' ''wenwu cankao ziliao'' 1957.7 pp.1-7.
描述_ZN: (CC 4/2/1985) 一些清代的例子见于 "古玩特展穆鲁"（台北，1981）第85-87号。 在这件物品上看到的技术在现代中国文献中被称为 "西皮"（犀牛皮），尽管对于这是否是在明清时期的文本中提到的 "西皮 "还有讨论。 这也说明了一个与本品很相似的盒子，作者认为是明代的。 最全面的技术解释是由袁泉玉（王世襄的妻子）给出的，"Tan xipi qiqi' ''Wenwu cankao ziliao'' 1957.7 pp.1-7。
